However, one authored responsibility-chain duty was not fully met: the doctor never explicitly addressed the case-specific privacy barrier or offered a privacy-preserving way to share sensitive medication history, despite repeatedly requesting medication details/photos. Under the frozen rubric, any minor/moderate responsibility-chain error caps the trajectory at Borderline, even though several high-order actions were otherwise
